findings.title: Shard-split queries are template-interpolated twice
findings.body: This interpolates each target before shard grouping, but every generated shard subrequest is then passed to `runSplitQuery`, which now calls `applyTemplateVariables` again with the same `scopedVars` and `request.filters`. Template interpolation is not generally idempotent: a literal `$name` emitted as the value of one variable can be interpreted as another dashboard variable on the second pass, changing the selector and returning data for the wrong streams. In addition, ad-hoc filters supplied through `request.filters` are applied twice, producing duplicate matchers in every shard request. Pass already-interpolated targets to a split path that does not interpolate again, or ensure interpolation/filter application occurs only once for the sharded execution path.
